pageTitle: Helping Young Children Regulate – Level 1 · Inspired
pageDescription: A practical one-hour ELS staff course on co-regulation: six modules, illustrated guides, expert video links, scenarios, an assessment and completion certificate.
safeguarding: Early Learning Schools · Connection before correction
heroLead: A calm adult. A supportive environment. Skills built together. Practical support for young children who find emotions, transitions and everyday demands difficult.
pilotNotice: For adult ELS teachers, teaching assistants and caregivers. Work at your own pace and use fictional examples only. Progress stays in this browser. Use your school’s current procedures and each child’s agreed support plan.
showActText: Six realistic scenarios, six quick checks, three illustrated explainers and a 20-question assessment. All safety-critical answers must be correct.
completionEvidenceText: Complete the modules and reflections, score at least 80% with every safety-critical answer correct, and acknowledge your responsibilities to unlock a named certificate.
timing: Modules and activities: 48 minutes · Assessment: 10 minutes · Acknowledgements: 2 minutes. Timing will be checked in a staff pilot.

quickGuideSubtitle: Safety first. Stay connected. Teach when ready.
quickGuideSteps: Notice your own pace and the child’s cues
Reduce noise, language and unnecessary demands
Offer calm presence and accessible choices
Get support if safety or supervision is at risk
Reconnect, repair and teach after recovery
